classification.difficultyReason: Combine the angle sum of a right triangle with equal angles standing on the same arc.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Circle with centre O, a vertical diameter, a perpendicular horizontal chord below the centre, an upper-left chord and a lower-right chord. The top angle is x and the bottom angle is 65 degrees. Ordinary source colours are replaced by black house geometry.
spec.mathematics: The horizontal chord is perpendicular to the diameter. The lower-right triangle has angles 90 degrees and 65 degrees, so its angle at the right circumference point is 25 degrees. That angle and x stand on the same arc.
spec.answerVisibility: Only x and the given 65-degree angle appear in the question diagram; the supplied 25-degree answer is withheld.

answer.worked:
In the lower-right triangle, the angle between the horizontal chord and the sloping chord is
$$\begin{aligned}180^\circ-90^\circ-65^\circ&=25^\circ.\end{aligned}$$
This angle and $x$ stand on the same arc, so
$$x=25^\circ.$$
